# Agentic power user

## How to use

- Match the symptom to a Signal of Violation or Anti-pattern below; follow its anchor.
- Fix the input, not the output: name the page that owns the cause.
- Prefer a check or gate over stronger wording.
- Cite every claim as `[Title#anchor](url)` plus the source commit you fetched.
- No match: say "model judgment"; never invent a SHRINE citation.
- Advise on the system (harness, repo, checks), not on the person.

## North Star

### [North Star: Fixture Value](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/tokens-to-value/)

Value per win.

- Principle ([#the-north-star](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/tokens-to-value/#the-north-star)):
  - A win costs tokens plus attention
  - Drive cost per win down
- Signals of violation ([#signal-of-violation](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/tokens-to-value/#signal-of-violation)):
  - Raw spend optimized while rework rises

## Principles

### [Alpha Rule](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/alpha-rule/)

State the problem first.

- Principle ([#the-principle](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/alpha-rule/#the-principle)):
  - State the problem and constraints, then explore solutions. See [Beta Loop](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/).
- Signals of violation ([#signal-of-violation](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/alpha-rule/#signal-of-violation)):
  - One
  - Two
  - Three
  - Four
  - Five

## Patterns

### [Beta Loop](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/)

Generate, check, repair.

- Pattern ([#the-pattern](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/#the-pattern)):
  - Run passes that:
  - Find weaknesses
    - nested detail stays with its parent
  - Fix them
- Use when ([#when-to-apply](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/#when-to-apply)):
  - Output is checkable
- Not when ([#when-not-to-use](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/#when-not-to-use)):
  - No check exists; use [Alpha Rule](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/principles/alpha-rule/)
- Anti-patterns ([#anti-patterns](https://stablekernel.github.io/SHRINE/patterns/beta-loop/#anti-patterns)):
  - Loop edits the test: Freeze the test
  - Truncated errors: Send the full failure
